summary: Banco Santander filed a US-equivalent Form 6-K reporting an update on its board-approved buyback programme. Between 10 and 16 September 2026 the bank repurchased 7,100,000 ordinary shares across XMAD, CEUX, TQEX and AQEU at weighted average prices of roughly EUR 12.59-12.81 per share. Cumulative cash spent since the 10 August 2026 commencement reaches EUR 558,894,930, about 30.6% of the programme's maximum investment amount, equating to roughly 18.2% of shares outstanding as of 2021. No advisor, premium or fixed completion date was disclosed; buybacks under the EU Market Abuse Regulation continue via open-market execution with periodic regulatory disclosure. Watch pace of remaining ~69% of the authorized programme and any impact on capital ratios or cancellation versus treasury-share treatment.
